description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $70 - $90 per hour 
 
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor
 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
 Working Schedule: Flexible – Work on your own schedule
 Payment Frequency: Weekly via Stripe or Wise
 About the Role
 We are seeking experienced Machine Learning Engineers with strong applied and experimental ML expertise to contribute to an AI research initiative focused on improving the capabilities of advanced AI models.
 In this role, you will evaluate the quality, correctness, and methodological rigor of machine learning tasks used to train and assess frontier AI systems. You will review experiment designs, model-selection decisions, hyperparameter tuning strategies, and evaluation methodologies to determine whether ML solutions are technically sound, reproducible, and supported by evidence.
 Your practical experience in developing, testing, and evaluating machine learning models will be essential in identifying methodological weaknesses, data leakage, metric manipulation, and unreliable experimental conclusions.
 You will provide structured, rubric-based feedback to help establish high-quality evaluation standards and improve the reliability of machine learning assessments.
 Important: This role focuses specifically on applied and experimental machine learning rigor. It is not an LLM application development or MLOps-focused position.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Machine Learning Task Evaluation 
 Evaluate applied machine learning tasks used for AI model training and assessment.
 Review experiment designs, model-selection approaches, and hyperparameter tuning methodologies.
 Assess whether ML solutions are technically correct, methodologically sound, and supported by reliable evidence.
 Critique modelling approaches and determine whether conclusions are justified by experimental results.
 Identify gaps in experimental reasoning, implementation choices, and evaluation practices.
 2. Data Quality & Experimental Rigor 
 Assess dataset quality and identify potential data leakage or contamination.
 Review train/test splits, cross-validation strategies, and data preprocessing workflows.
 Detect metric gaming, evaluation inconsistencies, and methodological shortcuts that could produce misleading results.
 Verify that evaluation metrics are appropriate for the problem being addressed.
 Ensure experiments follow sound statistical and machine learning practices.
 3. Model Evaluation & Reproducibility 
 Review model performance claims against experimental evidence and reported metrics.
 Assess model-selection decisions and compare alternative modelling approaches.
 Evaluate the reliability and reproducibility of experimental results.
 Identify discrepancies between reported performance and actual implementation outcomes.
 Provide recommendations to improve experimental design, evaluation methodology, and model reliability.
 4. Research Collaboration & Technical Feedback 
 Collaborate with AI researchers, engineers, and subject-matter experts to improve ML evaluation tasks.
 Provide clear, structured, and actionable written feedback based on predefined evaluation rubrics.
 Translate practical machine learning expertise into measurable standards for assessing model quality.
 Help refine task specifications and evaluation frameworks to ensure consistency and methodological accuracy.
 Required Qualifications & Skills
 Professional Experience 
 Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning, experimental ML, or a closely related technical field.
 Practical experience designing and conducting machine learning experiments.
 Strong understanding of model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation methodology.
 Experience analysing experimental results and validating machine learning performance claims.
 Machine Learning & Technical Expertise 
 Strong proficiency with standard machine learning frameworks and libraries, including:
 PyTorch
 TensorFlow
 Scikit-learn
 XGBoost
 Solid understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, model training, validation, and performance evaluation.
 Ability to assess different modelling approaches and determine their suitability for specific problems.
 Strong understanding of statistical evaluation, performance metrics, and experimental validation.
 Data Quality & Evaluation Methodology 
 Strong grasp of data-quality principles and experimental best practices.
 Experience identifying data leakage, metric gaming, and data contamination.
 Understanding of train/test separation, cross-validation hygiene, and preprocessing integrity.
 Ability to critically assess ML claims and determine whether conclusions are supported by evidence.
 Experience reproducing experiments and validating reported results.
 Analytical & Communication Skills 
 Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
 Excellent technical judgment and attention to detail.
 Ability to identify methodological flaws and explain their impact on model performance.
 Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide precise, structured, and actionable feedback.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience participating in machine learning competitions or benchmarks, such as Kaggle.
 Graduate-level research experience or academic publications in applied machine learning.
 Previous experience in technical task evaluation, peer review, or grading machine learning assignments.
 Experience benchmarking models and comparing alternative experimental approaches.
 Contributions to applied ML research or open-source machine learning projects.
 Important Role Clarification
 This position is focused on evaluating applied and experimental machine learning practices, including experiment design, model selection, hyperparameter optimisation, data quality, and evaluation methodology.
 It is not intended for candidates whose experience is limited to building LLM-powered applications, prompt engineering, or MLOps infrastructure without substantial hands-on applied ML experimentation experience.
 Contract & Payment Terms
 Engagement will be on an independent contractor basis.
 The role is fully remote and offers flexible working hours, allowing you to complete assignments on your own schedule.
 Project duration may be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on business requirements and individual performance.
 Payments will be processed weekly through Stripe or Wise, based on services rendered.
 The role will not require access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any current or former employer, client, or institution.
 Candidates requiring H-1B or STEM OPT sponsorship are not eligible for this opportunity at present.
